name: ZEC Distribution 5K + Micro
description: Hybrid two-tier ladder + SELL-side coin accumulation. BUY side: 4 micro ladders (0.4-1.6% below) for 'always trading' feel + 8 fibonacci ladders (4-60% below) — fib tier uses size_mode=fibonacci so unit multipliers match [1,1,2,3,5,8,13,21] (reachable on $4-6K capital). SELL side mirrors the same shape above market and auto-pairs each SELL with a BUY-back at sell_price/(1+coin_profit_percent). recycle_in_place=true makes each ladder re-arm AT ITS ORIGINAL PRICES the moment it closes, so closing the micro tier doesn't drag the fib tier through a global auto-restart that would re-anchor every level to a new market price (which would discard the whole fib plan). Accum micro unit bumped to 0.08 ZEC so coin_profit_percent (0.5%) clears step_size 0.001 and shows real coin gain instead of always rounding to 0. Stale BUYs (>4h old AND >4% below market) are auto-recycled to free up cap slots.
